source: MPC-Bench v2 design (MPC_BENCH_V2_DESIGN.md), section 1.4 'Held-out status' and section 3.6 'Predicted admission table', transcribed so that the release of the held-out forward anchors names a committed copy of every held-out prediction. The decisive statements are those of protocols/v2/hypotheses_v2.json; this file adds the rows of the admission table that no hypothesis states as a decision.

labels.R: replication of development results at the development regime

held_out_elements.held_out: label errors in the declared context (q = 0.1, 0.25), missing slow phase (partial declaration), jittered cue onsets, for NAS and IIM on family A
staggered driver with its time constants multiplied by 10 (S = C 0.5 s, hub 3 s, M = V 8 s; mostly outside the basis span 10 tau_c = 1 s) and with a saturating post-filter transform
EEG lead-field seed 20261001, conduction width 0.6, the paper-2 low-density montage, and the template-lead-field inverse at that regime; development used seed 20260928 and width 0.5
IIM-dir with drivers recorded on C1 (only reference-block anchors are computed before the freeze)
ring coupling 0.9 and 1.5 with the v5 estimator and occupancy gate

held_out_elements.element: IIM sensitivity to Hopf coupling at sensor level
held_out_elements.held_out: G sweep of the v2 sensor pipeline
echo time constants 6 s and 12 s; zero-mean workspace broadcast witness; mis-declared PDI access node on the content-on witnesses

corrections.kind: logical error, corrected before the release (CD-5)
corrections.reason: The original ABSENT predictions assumed the exact path that design decision 9 had already rejected: a concordant PDI count outside an admitted concordance cell is UNDEFINED(NO_SAMPLING_SE), never ABSENT, and the CD-5 battery admits the source cell only. The corrected values follow from the 3.6 rule on the development-regime forward rows (FM0 holds, no on-run is ABSENT, every null run is UNDEFINED, so pi0 = 0 and absent is vacuous on every view); the details are in the notes of HCv2-21.
